approved.en: Ukraine has deployed naval drones to strike Russian warships in Libya’s Benghazi port, claiming lawful self-defence, while Russia has violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle. NATO’s chief has pledged defence against a Russian space threat after reports of a planned nuclear satellite launch, and MI5 has warned UK firms supplying Ukraine of sabotage risk. The UN Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine’s power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

NATO-sjefen har lovet forsvar mot en russisk romtrussel etter rapporter om en planlagt oppskyting av en atomisk satellitt, og MI5 har advart britiske firmaer som leverer til Ukraina om sabotasje-risiko. FNs sikkerhetsråd advarte om at vinterangrep på Ukrainas strømnett og skipsfarten i Svartehavet truer liv og den globale matforsyningen. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The defense ministry ordered nationwide troop deployment and the closure of oil smuggling routes, and a drone strike destroyed a militant vehicle in Anbar province. Hezbollah fighters were transferred onto Popular Mobilization Forces payroll, and Germany arrested an Iraqi duo suspected of plotting synagogue attacks. An Iraqi court sentenced eight French nationals to life imprisonment for IS group membership, and UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024.

Forsvarsdepartementet beordret landsomfattende troppeutplassering og stenging av oljesmuglingsruter, og et droneram ødela et militant kjøretøy i provinsen Anbar. approved.en: RSF forces have intensified drone strikes, hitting a United Nations building and residential areas in Khartoum and killing four people, while a separate drone attack in Blue Nile state killed 19 civilians and displaced thousands near Ed Damazin. RSF-aligned troops assaulted aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties. A RSF counterintelligence chief and a commander defected to the Sudanese army in Khartoum, indicating shifting loyalties. Ethiopia offered to host inclusive Sudan peace talks and propose a national unity government, but Sudan rejected the offer, questioning Ethiopia's neutrality. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

RSF-tilknyttede styrker angrep hjelpekontorer i Nyala og et tilfluktssted i Vest-Kordofan, noe som førte til sivile tap. approved.en: Armed clashes and intercommunal violence persist in South Sudan, with rebel and SPLA-IO forces attacking civilians in Tonj East, Warrap State and Greater Pibor, while worshippers were attacked in Gorom refugee camp and a teen was killed for refusing an arranged marriage. UNMISS is supporting deterrence efforts in Tonj East and calling for stronger civilian protection during a visit to Unity, and the Gender Ministry has raised concerns about violence against women and children ahead of a 16 Days campaign. President Kiir told an Oil and Power conference that partnerships, not speeches, must change lives, after travelling to Ethiopia and holding investment talks with Saudi Arabia in Riyadh. A US senator warned that Uganda is playing a destabilising role, the Crisis Group urged African intervention, and the UNDP resident representative issued a message of solidarity. There were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

UNMISS støtter avskrekkingsinnsats i Tonj East og oppfordrer til sterkere sivile beskyttelsestiltak under et besøk i Unity, og Kjønnsdepartementet har uttrykt bekymring for vold mot kvinner og barn i forkant av en 16‑dagers kampanje. President Kiir sa på en olje‑ og kraftkonferanse at partnerskap, ikke taler, må endre liv, etter reise til Etiopia og investeringssamtaler med Saudi-Arabia i Riyadh. En amerikansk senator advarte om at Uganda spiller en destabiliserende rolle, Crisis Group oppfordret til afrikansk intervensjon, og UNDP-representanten i landet sendte en solidaritetsmelding. Det var 2 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
